result.topic_en: An algebraic calculation solving a linear equation of the form [(aa,2)+n]z = (cl,2)+nD for z, substituting D = C + γ and simplifying to z = C + nγ/((aa,2)+n), with (aa,2) also denoted p.

methods.what: Solving a linear equation for z after adding n to the coefficient and nD to the right-hand side (weighted combination / weighted mean of C and D)
Substituting D = C + γ to express the solution as C plus a correction term
